summary: Record Claude MCP initialization independently of native provider activity.

schema.detail: Uses the existing harness.diagnostic kind and existing code/status/driver/incarnation_id/reason fields. Code is an existing unconstrained string. No registry/schema bytes or digest change.

rules.detail: Mailbox admission, binding/incarnation fences and canonical state ordering remain unchanged. The diagnostic does not grant attachment.

compatibility.detail: New channel images record initialization as component evidence instead of publishing harness.observed state ready. Native provider observations retain idle/working/other activity. A fresh channel-initialized key namespace keeps legacy channel-ready inputs immutable. Older channel images can still publish ready.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond normal channel image rollout.

manual.detail: No hook or settings repair required.

recovery.detail: Rollback restores legacy ready publication. This change does not repair a legacy ready claim already committed or prove cancellation of an older image request that was in flight during upgrade.
